The '''Chiss Secret Police''' was a clandestine agency which had resources to conduct covert operations on behalf of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] during the era of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]]. Through their [[Chiss–Imperial treaty|alliance]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], it was possible for officers of the Secret Police to join [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]].

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|That's not an Imperial Intelligence officer speaking. That's a member of the Chiss Secret Police.|Saganu|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The Chiss Secret Police are mentioned in conversation with [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Saganu]] in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' if the player is a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Imperial Agent]]. The Chiss Imperial Agent can also mention that they were a former member of the Chiss Secret Police in conversation with [[Amin-Le]], while hunting [[Albathius|The Shining Man]] on [[Voss]].
